Priya (CSM): Morning @Evan — saw your onboarding form for the 'novaflow-domain-13b' custom weights. Quick sync — can you confirm primary success metrics and any blockers for your upcoming renewal? :coffee:
Evan (NovaFlow): Hi Priya — thanks. Renewal in 2 weeks, execs want proof the model won't introduce hallucinations on warranty text and that latency stays under 150ms p95. We also need PHI-safe handling for customer notes.
Priya (CSM): Understood. Two parallel asks: safety/perf for the renewal committee, and the longer-term Private/HSM path if required. @Raina can we run a short eval plan and a week-long dedicated trial?
Raina (Solutions Eng): Yep. Proposed immediate actions: 1) a 72h automated eval against our hallucination rubric (precision/recall on entity extraction + hallucination score), 2) a readiness test on Dedicated for a 7-day perf comparison, 3) enable model-level redaction + post-processing hooks for PHI. Need dataset and a few sample prompts.
Evan (NovaFlow): I'll drop a 1k-row test set and a list of sensitive fields. Also, some inputs include scanned OCR; we want to know if tokenization changes affect safety.
Sam (Security): FYI — for PHI we require either customer-side redaction or KMS-wrapped keys and audit logs. If NovaFlow prefers hosted, we can enable retention controls and token-level logging off. For Private, we can advise HSM integration.
Priya (CSM): Good. Can you classify the test cases as "must-pass" vs "informational"? The renewal needs must-pass >= 98% for no-hit hallucinations and false-positive under 1.5% for entity masking.
Evan (NovaFlow): I'll label them. Also can we get A/B eval against redwood-13b-standard so we can show delta? Execs asked for delta reports.
Raina (Solutions Eng): We'll run A/B with identical prompts and measure: hallucination rate, avg latency, p95 latency, token cost, and inference errors. Can you confirm traffic shape? QPS and batch sizes?
Evan (NovaFlow): Baseline QPS 25, burst to 120 during peak, batch size 4, typical payload 300 tokens, but OCR docs can go to 2k tokens.
Raina (Solutions Eng): Noted. For large docs we recommend prefix-KV caching + chunking. We'll include a suggested chunking strategy in the runbook.
QA-bot: New eval job queued: eval/novaflow-1742351111-run1 (72h hallucination rubric + A/B). Estimated completion 2024-10-04T18:00:00Z.
Priya (CSM): Timeline proposal: today — collect artifacts and labels; tomorrow — start eval run; 72h later — perf trial on Dedicated; 7 days trial window to compare. Deliverable: one-pager with pass/fail, graphs, and renewal recommendation. Are you aligned, @Evan?
Evan (NovaFlow): Aligned. One more ask: our legal team wants a written statement about model fine-tuning provenance (no third-party sensitive corpora). Can you include a provenance summary?
Sam (Security): We'll provide a provenance attestation template and a checklist for dataset curation. If any customer data was used to finetune the model, we need explicit consent records.
Priya (CSM): I'll capture action items: 1) Evan upload dataset & sensitive-field list to support ticket; 2) Raina kick off eval + Dedicated trial; 3) Sam prepare provenance & PHI checklist; 4) I'll compile renewal one-pager and schedule a 30m exec review after results.
Evan (NovaFlow): Uploaded dataset (support#12345) and sample OCR files. Thanks — please flag if any dataset rows need redaction before landing on your infra.
Raina (Solutions Eng): Starting eval job now. Canary config: 2 nodes, autoscale disabled, sampling 10% of live traffic for A/B to avoid user impact. We'll collect: latency histograms, hallucination labels, token usage, and per-prompt diffs.
QA-bot: Eval/novaflow-1742351111-run1: 12% complete. Current hallucination rate (A): 2.8%, (B standard): 3.1%. p95 latency (A): 142ms, (B): 155ms.
Priya (CSM): Early good signs. Keep me posted. If final metrics meet must-pass, we'll mark renewal green and propose Dedicated trial pricing for long-term. :white_check_mark:
Evan (NovaFlow): Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll loop Legal and Product into the support thread for provenance and consent docs.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll close the loop after the full eval. If anything changes ping me here. :rocket:
